title: Phenotype-Oriented Characterization of NSC828786 Identifies Convergent HPN-AMACR-Associated Transcriptomic Signatures in Prostate Adenocarcinoma and Broad-Spectrum Antiproliferative Activity.
snippet: Prostate cancer remains a major cause of cancer-related mortality, and new therapeutic strategies are needed for advanced disease. title: Sickle Cell Disease: From Ancient Origins to Modern Breakthroughs in Gene Therapy.
